description: clavex — Token Introspection (RFC 7662) local test plan. NOT an OIDF conformance suite plan. Use as a reference for manual or script-based smoke tests against the introspection endpoint.

testScenarios.description: Introspect a valid, non-expired access token — must return active:true with sub, iat, exp, scope
Introspect a valid refresh token — must return active:true
Introspect a revoked token — must return active:false
Introspect an expired access token — must return active:false
Introspect a random string not matching any token — must return active:false
Introspect without client credentials — must return 401
